assistant.intro: Soon you’ll be able to ask Claude about your money and let it make changes, always with your confirmation.
assistant.example1: How much did I spend on groceries in October?

settings.title: Settings
settings.ibanOptional: Optional. Helps match transfers between your own accounts.
settings.languageHint: More languages can be added later.
settings.backupsHint: Backups are encrypted with your backup password and can be restored on any computer.
settings.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. Write it down somewhere safe: without it, a backup can’t be opened. Kasboek keeps a copy in your system’s secure storage so automatic backups can run.
settings.restoreBody: This replaces everything in Kasboek with the backup from {{date}}. Your current data is saved as a safety backup first. Kasboek restarts afterwards.
settings.autoHint: Once a day, to a folder you choose. A synced folder (OneDrive, iCloud Drive, Dropbox) or a USB drive works well.
settings.securityHint: How your data is protected on this computer.
settings.keyStorageWeak: Not protected: no system keyring found
settings.keyStorageWeakHint: On Linux, install and unlock GNOME Keyring or KWallet, then restart Kasboek.
